title: Metric Definition Schema
description: Standard schema for defining business metrics. Every certified metric must have a definition conforming to this schema.

metric_name.description: Canonical metric name following the naming standard (snake_case)

display_name.description: Human-readable name for dashboards and reports (Title Case)

description.description: Clear, unambiguous description of what the metric measures and why it matters
examples: Count of unique users who triggered at least one active_session event within a calendar month. This metric measures product engagement breadth and is the primary indicator of product adoption.

formula.description: The mathematical definition of the metric

examples: (Churned customers at end of period) / (Total customers at start of period)

numerator.description: The numerator of the metric (or the full expression for non-ratio metrics)

denominator.description: The denominator for ratio/rate metrics. Null for count/sum metrics.

sql.description: Reference SQL implementation (points to dbt model or warehouse query)
examples: SELECT date_trunc('month', event_date) AS period, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS value FROM analytics.fct_user_activity WHERE event_name = 'active_session' GROUP BY 1

data_source.description: Where the data for this metric originates

warehouse_table.description: Fully qualified table name in the data warehouse

dbt_model.description: The dbt model that produces this data

grain.description: The level of detail at which the metric is calculated

dimensions.description: Available dimensions for breaking down this metric

values.description: Possible values if the dimension is categorical

owner.description: The person accountable for this metric definition

tier.description: Importance tier affecting SLA and governance requirements

target_value.description: Target value for the current period

direction.description: Whether the goal is to increase, decrease, or maintain the metric

known_limitations.description: Documented limitations, caveats, and known issues with this metric
examples: Does not include users who interact only via API (server-side only).
Undercounts by approximately 5-8% due to ad-blocker impact on client-side tracking.
Definition changed on 2024-06-01: previously included inactive sessions.

related_metrics.description: Other metrics that are related or commonly compared

changelog.description: History of changes to this metric definition

examples.author: Carlos Santos
examples.change: Added platform dimension, updated SQL to use new events table

created_at.description: Date the metric was first defined

updated_at.description: Date the metric definition was last updated
